name: DuPont
description: DuPont is now a much smaller specialty-materials company after spinning off its electronics business as Qnity (Nov 1, 2025), selling its Mobility & Materials businesses and selling Aramids (Kevlar, Nomex; closed April 1, 2026 for about $1.2B). Continuing operations had $6.85B of 2025 sales in two segments: Healthcare & Water Technologies (medical packaging and device components, water filtration) and Diversified Industrials (building materials such as Tyvek and Corian, and industrial components, adhesives, lubricants and printing plates). Customers buy engineered products repeatedly, often specified into a device, building or vehicle. A 1-for-3 reverse stock split took effect June 24, 2026.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label as shown in Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (sector and sub-industry columns only; that list does not give industry group or industry). Read 2026-09-30.

employees.note: Approximately 15,000 including about 1,700 in the Aramids business sold April 1, 2026 (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Healthcare & Water Technologies
businessLines.how: Medical device and pharma makers buy specified packaging and components; utilities, industrial plants and desalination buyers purchase membranes and resins and then replacement elements over time.
businessLines.description: Healthcare Technologies (Tyvek medical packaging, Tychem protective suits, medical device components) and Water Technologies (Amberlite ion exchange resins, Filmtec reverse osmosis, ultrafiltration modules).

businessLines.name: Diversified Industrials
businessLines.how: Builders, remodelers, auto, aerospace and printing OEMs buy products specified into their jobs or platforms; volumes follow construction and industrial cycles.
businessLines.description: Building Technologies (Tyvek house wrap, Styrofoam insulation, Corian surfaces) and Industrial Technologies (Vespel shapes, Molykote lubricants, Betaforce/Betaseal adhesives, Cyrel printing plates).

brands.name: Tyvek, Tychem, Amberlite, Filmtec, Styrofoam, Corian, Vespel, Molykote, Betaforce, Cyrel
brands.note: Named brands in 10-K; no per-brand sales given
